Adding VAT details from our side. Spectra is EU-registered but invoices will be issued from Redwood US (we have a US entity handling hosted customers). Two options:

A) Treat as B2B reverse-charge (supply from US entity) — Spectra provides VAT registration number and we reference it on the invoice; Spectra will self-account for VAT in Ireland.
B) If Spectra requires an EU VAT invoice (local VAT charged), we can route through our EU billing entity but that requires a separate contract line and tax setup (longer lead time).

Requested evidence for AP:
- Copy of PO (Spectra PO#)
- Spectra VAT ID / Irish tax registration (if option A applies)
- RDW invoice schedule (attached) showing invoice numbers and net/gross breakdown per drawdown
- Bank remittance instructions (we will provide Redwood US bank details; for EU routing we will provide EU bank details if chosen)

Bank details (redacted here — we will send a single-line remittance block for the PO):
- Redwood US (Wells Fargo) — Account ending **3421 — Reference: RDW-2781

I recommend Option A unless Spectra specifically requires local VAT charge. Option A keeps the drawdown cadence intact and avoids tax registration delays.
